name: Realistic 2x/1x Virtual Shifting
description: Emulates real-life 2x/1x front chainring and rear cassette shifting with configurable tooth counts, sequential ratio mode for Zwift Click, and an on-screen gear HUD.

settings.label: Front Chainrings (comma-separated teeth, small to big)
settings.description: Example: '30, 46' for GRX 2x, '34, 50' for Road Compact, or '40' for 1x.

settings.label: Sequential Ratio Mode (lowest to highest gear)
settings.description: 'auto' enables sequential ratio shifting automatically when Zwift Click / Click v2 is connected (and no Zwift Ride controller is connected).

settings.label: Key: Rear Shift Harder (RS2 / Click +)
settings.description: Key for harder gear (smaller cog, or next higher ratio in sequential mode).

settings.label: Key: Rear Shift Easier (RS1 / Click -)
settings.description: Key for easier gear (larger cog, or next lower ratio in sequential mode).

settings.label: Key: Front Shift Big Ring / Toggle (LS2)
settings.description: Key for Left Shifter Up (or toggle if LS1 & LS2 both use 'q').

settings.label: Key: Front Shift Small Ring / Toggle (LS1)
settings.description: Key for Left Shifter Down (if same as Front Up, toggles between 30T and 46T).
